text:
Nina: quick design review  thresholds row: are we doing inline dropdown for units or a small toggle (short / verbose)? concern: compact rows need to stay tight but accessible. screenshot: https://img.redwood.test/ux/thresholds-compact.png

Ravi: inline dropdown is explicit, toggle is lighter. If toggle, visually show `5m` but aria-label the verbose form. e.g. `aria-label="per 5 minutes"`.

Hector: suppression preview overlap at narrow widths still repros. On 320px the pills wrap under but sit on top of the rule name. Mobile should show first two pills + "+N more" stacked list. Avoid horizontal scroll for screen readers.

Clara: Copy tweak: change helper from `when error rate > 2%` to `when error rate exceeds 2% (over 5m)` so timeframe and comparator are explicit. Also preview text: `Previewing 3 channels 1 muted` reads clearer than `Preview (3)`.

a11y-bot: Contrast check: muted-pill text #666 on #fff = 4.0 (fails AA 14px). Recommend #2F2F2F or font-weight 600. Also suggest aria-live polite for suppression toggle changes: announce `2 channels muted`.

Ravi: UX edge: routing fallback info should be visible in preview: `Primary: Slack (low latency) • Fallback: Email (on error)`. Add tooltip explaining fallback logic.

Nina: Action items: Ravi mock dropdown + toggle with aria-labels, Hector add mobile stacked preview pattern, Clara update microcopy in figma, a11y-bot to provide exact color tokens. Target: next design sync Wednesday.

Ravi: noted, will post updated frames by Tuesday EOD.

Nina: thanks :thumbsup:
